subject: Urgent: importer name on paperwork causing customs hold
messages:
From: Mike Chen <mike@fastdrayage.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: customs hold on 2 crates - importer name mismatch

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Quick heads-up — CBP placed two exhibit crates for your shipment (BOL_7890) on hold at the bonded warehouse this morning. The hold reason from the broker is an importer-of-record name mismatch: the commercial invoice submitted shows "Redwood, Inc." while CBP expects the legal importer name on file, which appears to be "Redwood Inference, Inc."

I attached the BOL and the commercial invoice we filed. CBP is refusing release until the invoice is corrected and an update is filed by the broker or a POA (power of attorney) is provided designating the IOR. The bonded warehouse is charging a daily storage fee while we await corrected docs.

What I need from you ASAP:
- Confirm the exact legal importer name (as registered with your bank/FEIN).
- If you have a signed POA or an IOR designation doc we can forward, please attach.
- If you prefer, we can reissue the invoice showing the corrected importer name, but I need authorization to do that.

Attachements: BOL_7890.pdf, commercial_invoice_7890.pdf

I know this is time-sensitive for the booth move-in. Please advise and we will queue the amendment with customs the moment we have the correct info.

Thanks,
Mike Chen
Fast Drayage + Customs
mike@fastdrayage.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
